name: Resveratrol
short: Generally well tolerated up to 1 g/day; 2.5 to 5 g/day caused mild to moderate gut symptoms. Changes CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9 and CYP1A2 activity, so may interact with medicines.
text: A systematic review of almost 200 clinical studies concluded that resveratrol is generally well tolerated at doses up to 1 g/day. In a 29-day study in 40 healthy volunteers, resveratrol was safe, but doses of 2.5 and 5 g daily caused mild to moderate gastrointestinal symptoms. In another healthy-volunteer study, 1 g daily for 4 weeks inhibited CYP3A4, CYP2D6 and CYP2C9 and induced CYP1A2, which the authors said could lead to more adverse drug reactions or altered effectiveness of medicines processed by these enzymes.
